theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_cm_cylinder_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (y : Euclidean N) (h : Euclidean N → ℝ) (τ σ ρ E : ℝ), Measurable h → (∀ z, 0 ≤ h z ∧ h z ≤ 1) → (∀ z, ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ → h z = 1) → (∀ z, 2 * τ ≤ ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ → h z = 0) → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≠ ∞ → (∫ z in closedBall y σ, h z ∂μ) / σ ^ n ≤ (∫ z in closedBall y ρ, h z ∂μ) / ρ ^ n + E → μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall y ρ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < 2 * τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n + ENNReal.ofReal E
